hints: Think of the grid as a series of rings, each one read in four straight runs. What tells you where a ring starts and ends?
Four boundaries - top, bottom, left, right - that close in by one after each run.
Read the top row, then move `top` down; read the right column, then move `right` in; and so on. Stop when the boundaries cross.
Before the bottom row and the left column, check that a row or column is still left - a ring that is one cell thick has already been read by the first two runs.
